source.note: Frozen synthetic library corpus: 12 hand-written queries, 28 allowed states per family, 4 positive controls in the upstream corpus.

ddl: CREATE TABLE lib_readers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL UNIQUE)
CREATE TABLE lib_books(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL UNIQUE, price INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE lib_loans(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, reader_id INTEGER NOT NULL, book_id INTEGER NOT NULL, day_no INTEGER NOT NULL, fee INTEGER NOT NULL, returned INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(reader_id) REFERENCES lib_readers(id), FOREIGN KEY(book_id) REFERENCES lib_books(id))

families.reference_sql: SELECT r.id FROM lib_readers r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lib_loans l WHERE l.reader_id=r.id) ORDER BY r.id
SELECT r.id,COUNT(l.id) AS n FROM lib_readers r LEFT JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id
SELECT r.id FROM lib_readers r LEFT JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id GROUP BY r.id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(l.fee),0)=0 ORDER BY r.id
SELECT reader_id,COUNT(CASE WHEN returned=1 THEN 1 END) AS n FROM lib_loans GROUP BY reader_id ORDER BY reader_id
SELECT DISTINCT r.id FROM lib_readers r JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id JOIN lib_books b ON b.id=l.book_id WHERE b.price<=20 ORDER BY r.id
SELECT l.id,l.reader_id,l.day_no FROM lib_loans l WHERE l.day_no=(SELECT MAX(x.day_no) FROM lib_loans x WHERE x.reader_id=l.reader_id) ORDER BY l.id
families.intent: Все выдачи в последний день читателя

families.reference_sql: SELECT id,price FROM lib_books WHERE price BETWEEN 10 AND 20 ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM lib_loans WHERE returned<>1 ORDER BY id
SELECT r.id,l.id AS loan_id FROM lib_readers r LEFT JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id AND l.returned=0 ORDER BY r.id,l.id
SELECT reader_id FROM lib_loans WHERE returned=0 UNION ALL SELECT reader_id FROM lib_loans WHERE fee=0 ORDER BY reader_id

SELECT r.id FROM lib_readers r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lib_loans l WHERE l.reader_id=r.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lib_loans l WHERE l.reader_id=r.id AND (l.returned<>1 OR l.returned IS NULL)) ORDER BY r.id
families.intent: Читатели, у которых все выдачи возвращены

families.reference_sql: SELECT id,price FROM lib_books ORDER BY price DESC,id ASC LIMIT 2
families.intent: Две самые дорогие книги с разрешением равенств

families.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, COALESCE(SUM(l.fee),0) AS total FROM lib_readers r LEFT JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id
families.intent: Сумма сборов по читателям, включая ноль

families.reference_sql: SELECT l.reader_id, AVG(l.fee) AS avg_fee FROM lib_loans l GROUP BY l.reader_id ORDER BY l.reader_id
SELECT l.reader_id, MAX(l.fee) AS max_fee FROM lib_loans l GROUP BY l.reader_id ORDER BY l.reader_id
SELECT l.reader_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.book_id) AS n FROM lib_loans l GROUP BY l.reader_id ORDER BY l.reader_id
SELECT l.reader_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lib_loans l GROUP BY l.reader_id ORDER BY l.reader_id
SELECT l.reader_id, SUM(CASE WHEN l.returned=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_cnt FROM lib_loans l GROUP BY l.reader_id ORDER BY l.reader_id
SELECT l.reader_id, SUM(l.fee) AS total FROM lib_loans l GROUP BY l.reader_id HAVING SUM(l.fee) > 10 ORDER BY l.reader_id
SELECT l.reader_id FROM lib_loans l GROUP BY l.reader_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY l.reader_id
families.intent: Читатели с двумя и более выдачами

families.reference_sql: SELECT b.id, SUM(l.fee) AS total FROM lib_books b LEFT JOIN lib_loans l ON l.book_id=b.id GROUP BY b.id ORDER BY b.id
families.intent: Сумма сборов по книгам, включая ноль

families.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(fee) AS total_fee, AVG(fee) AS avg_fee FROM lib_loans
SELECT r.id, b.title FROM lib_readers r JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id JOIN lib_books b ON b.id=l.book_id ORDER BY r.id, b.title
SELECT DISTINCT r.id FROM lib_readers r JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id WHERE l.fee=0 ORDER BY r.id
SELECT r.id, l.id AS loan_id FROM lib_readers r LEFT JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id ORDER BY r.id, l.id
families.intent: Все читатели и их выдачи, включая отсутствующие

families.reference_sql: SELECT l.id, b.price FROM lib_loans l JOIN lib_books b ON b.id=l.book_id WHERE b.price > 15 ORDER BY l.id
SELECT r.id, MIN(b.price) AS min_price FROM lib_readers r JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id JOIN lib_books b ON b.id=l.book_id GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id
SELECT a.id, b.id FROM lib_loans a JOIN lib_loans b ON a.day_no=b.day_no AND a.id < b.id ORDER BY a.id, b.id
SELECT DISTINCT l1.reader_id FROM lib_loans l1 JOIN lib_loans l2 ON l1.reader_id=l2.reader_id AND l1.book_id=l2.book_id AND l1.id<l2.id ORDER BY l1.reader_id
SELECT DISTINCT b.id FROM lib_books b JOIN lib_books o ON o.id<>b.id AND o.price>b.price ORDER BY b.id
families.intent: Книги дешевле хотя бы одной другой

families.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, COUNT(l.id) AS n, SUM(l.fee) AS total FROM lib_readers r LEFT JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id
families.intent: Число выдач и сумма сборов по читателям

families.reference_sql: SELECT l.id, b.title FROM lib_loans l JOIN lib_books b ON b.id=l.book_id WHERE l.day_no=(SELECT MAX(x.day_no) FROM lib_loans x WHERE x.reader_id=l.reader_id) ORDER BY l.id
families.intent: Названия книг из последней выдачи читателя

families.reference_sql: SELECT id, fee FROM lib_loans WHERE fee BETWEEN 0 AND 2 ORDER BY id
families.intent: Выдачи со сбором в замкнутом диапазоне

families.reference_sql: SELECT id FROM lib_loans WHERE fee IN (0,1,2) ORDER BY id
families.intent: Выдачи с одним из перечисленных сборов

families.reference_sql: SELECT id FROM lib_loans WHERE returned IS NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM lib_loans WHERE fee=0 OR returned=0 ORDER BY id
families.intent: Выдачи с нулевым сбором или активные

families.reference_sql: SELECT id, title FROM lib_books WHERE title LIKE 'Book%' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM lib_loans WHERE day_no BETWEEN 1 AND 3 ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM lib_books WHERE price < 10 OR price > 20 ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM lib_loans WHERE returned IN (0,1) ORDER BY id
SELECT b.id FROM lib_books b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lib_loans l WHERE l.book_id=b.id) ORDER BY b.id
families.intent: Книги, которые ни разу не выдавались

families.reference_sql: SELECT r.id FROM lib_readers r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lib_loans l WHERE l.reader_id=r.id) ORDER BY r.id
SELECT b.id FROM lib_books b WHERE b.id IN (SELECT l.book_id FROM lib_loans l) ORDER BY b.id
SELECT b.id FROM lib_books b WHERE b.id NOT IN (SELECT l.book_id FROM lib_loans l) ORDER BY b.id
families.intent: Книги, не входящие в множество выданных

families.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lib_loans l WHERE l.reader_id=r.id) AS n FROM lib_readers r ORDER BY r.id
SELECT id FROM lib_loans WHERE fee > (SELECT AVG(fee) FROM lib_loans) ORDER BY id
SELECT x.reader_id, x.n FROM (SELECT l.reader_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lib_loans l GROUP BY l.reader_id) x WHERE x.n >= 2 ORDER BY x.reader_id
families.intent: Читатели с двумя и более выдачами через производную таблицу

families.reference_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT id, day_no FROM lib_loans) SELECT id FROM ranked WHERE day_no = 1 ORDER BY id
families.intent: Выдачи первого дня через общее табличное выражение

families.reference_sql: SELECT id, fee FROM lib_loans ORDER BY fee, id
SELECT id FROM lib_books ORDER BY price DESC, id
SELECT id FROM lib_loans ORDER BY id LIMIT 3
SELECT id, name FROM lib_readers ORDER BY name
SELECT DISTINCT price FROM lib_books ORDER BY price
SELECT day_no, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lib_loans GROUP BY day_no ORDER BY n DESC, day_no
families.intent: Число выдач по дням, упорядоченное по счётчику

families.reference_sql: SELECT book_id FROM lib_loans WHERE returned=0 UNION ALL SELECT book_id FROM lib_loans WHERE fee=0 ORDER BY book_id
families.intent: Объединение выданных книг с сохранением повторов

families.reference_sql: SELECT reader_id FROM lib_loans WHERE returned=0 UNION SELECT reader_id FROM lib_loans WHERE fee=0 ORDER BY reader_id
SELECT reader_id, COUNT(*) AS star_cnt, COUNT(returned) AS returned_cnt FROM lib_loans GROUP BY reader_id ORDER BY reader_id
families.intent: Число строк против числа известных отметок возврата

families.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lib_readers r JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id JOIN lib_books b ON b.id=l.book_id GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id
SELECT id FROM lib_books WHERE price >= 20 ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM lib_books WHERE price > 10 AND price < 20 ORDER BY id
SELECT reader_id FROM lib_loans GROUP BY reader_id HAVING SUM(fee) = 0 ORDER BY reader_id
SELECT r.id FROM lib_readers r LEFT JOIN lib_loans l ON l.reader_id=r.id WHERE l.id IS NULL ORDER BY r.id
families.intent: Читатели без единой выдачи через соединение

families.reference_sql: SELECT r.id FROM lib_readers r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lib_loans l WHERE l.reader_id=r.id AND l.returned IS NULL) ORDER BY r.id
families.intent: Читатели с выдачей без отметки возврата

families.reference_sql: SELECT l.reader_id FROM lib_loans l GROUP BY l.reader_id HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(returned) ORDER BY l.reader_id
families.intent: Читатели, у которых у всех выдач есть отметка возврата

families.reference_sql: SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM lib_loans ORDER BY id
SELECT reader_id, fee, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY reader_id ORDER BY fee DESC) AS rnk FROM lib_loans ORDER BY reader_id, rnk, fee DESC, id
SELECT reader_id, id, SUM(fee) OVER (PARTITION BY reader_id ORDER BY id) AS running FROM lib_loans ORDER BY reader_id, id
families.intent: Нарастающая сумма сборов по выдачам читателя

families.reference_sql: SELECT id, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS price_rank FROM lib_books ORDER BY id

schema_description: Синтетическая библиотека: читатели, книги, выдачи. NULL допускается только в lib_loans.returned.

profile_legend.aggregate: одна агрегатная функция или несколько по одной группировке
profile_legend.outer_join_aggregate: внешнее соединение с агрегатом (включая нулевые группы)
profile_legend.anti_join_null: анти-соединение через LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL
profile_legend.outer_join_predicate: внешнее соединение с предикатом в ON
profile_legend.semi_anti_join: комбинация EXISTS и NOT EXISTS в одном запросе
profile_legend.anti_join_subquery: анти-соединение через NOT EXISTS в подзапросе
profile_legend.top_n_ties: сортировка с LIMIT при возможных равенствах

breaking_profile_legend.multiplicity: состояние с повторяющимися строками и кратностями
breaking_profile_legend.nullable: состояние с NULL в необязательном столбце
breaking_profile_legend.zero_value: состояние с нулевой суммой или нулевым счётом
